title: Rig and Frac Crew of the Quarter Winners (3Q 2026)
body_markdown:
Each quarter, the HSER and Operations teams recognize rig and frac crews that stand out for their exceptional safety performance, operational excellence and teamwork — highlighting the incredible work our field teams deliver every day.


**Workover Rig of the Quarter – **Fortis 1085****
**Haynesville (Louisiana** )


*“Fortis 1085 deserves to be recognized as the Q3 Rig of the Quarter for delivering exceptional safety performance with zero incidents for the quarter. The crew’s ability to consistently operate safely, efficiently and with discipline demonstrates the kind of performance and safety culture we want to recognize and replicate across our operations.”*


– *Cody McCormick, Manager – Workover*


---


**Drilling Rig of the Quarter** – ****Patterson 582****
**NE App (Pennsylvania** )


*“The Patterson 582 team continues to demonstrate what it means to take pride in their work, support one another and maintain high standards throughout daily drilling operations. Their willingness to look out for one another and take ownership of the work being performed reflects a strong commitment to Expand Energy’s safety expectations.*


*Equally important is the positive working relationship between Patterson personnel, Expand Energy representatives and supporting service providers. This collaboration promotes open communication, shared responsibility and a common goal of completing each task safely and efficiently.”*


– *Ronnie Handy, Contract Drilling Field Safety Representative III*


---


****Frac Crew of the Quarter – ****Liberty Falcon********
******Haynesville (Louisiana** )****


*“Liberty Falcon earned Frac Crew of the Quarter for its proactive safety leadership and commitment to disciplined operational execution — completing their work with zero SIF events or OSHA recordable injuries. Delivering at this level while managing risk exposures requires planning, communication, hazard recognition, disciplined execution and people willing to look out for one another.”*


– *Harris Marcom, Manager – HSE Completions & Emergency Response*
